rules.basis: The module sheets state the output at standard test conditions as '450 Wp'; the watt-peak is the module's STC watt.
The module sheets state Voc at STC; the NMOT column beside it is at the module's operating temperature and is not read.
The module sheets state Isc at STC beside the NMOT figure, which is not read.
The module sheets call the voltage at maximum power 'Rated voltage (Vmpp)'; the STC column is read.
The module sheets call the current at maximum power 'Rated current (Impp)'; one sheet's text renders the I as a lowercase L, which is the same heading.
The Force HT sheet states the PV input power as a bare number under 'PV' whose column is in watts, 11000 to 22500, for the whole unit.
The Force HT sheet states the short-circuit limit per tracker as '25/25/25' in an amps column, read as one per-input figure.

The Force HT sheet's PV section states 'Max. DC voltage' as 1000 in a volts column, above the start-up and nominal operating voltages: the open-circuit limit of the array. The bare name is read on that sheet only.
The PS2900H series and HP-6M battery sheets state 'Nominal Voltage', 115.2 V and up for the stacks and '51.2 V d.c.' for the HP-6M.
The PS2900H series sheet states 'Nominal Capacity' in watt-hours, 5760 to 20160, which is the stack's energy; the PS2900H-M sheet prints 'Normal energy' for 'nominal energy', 2.88 kWh.
The PS2900H-M sheet prints 'Normal capacity' for 'nominal capacity', 50 Ah, on a lithium pack.
The PS2900H sheets state one current for charge and discharge, 50 A, read under both keys.
The PS2900H sheets state one current for charge and discharge, 50 A, read under both keys.
The PS2900H-M sheet states the peak discharge current with its duration in the name, 65 A for 60 s.

The HP-6M datasheet states the inverter's continuous output as 'Rated Power', 3600 W. The bare names are read on the HP-6M sheets only: the EV charger sheet prints 'Rated Power' for the A11's 11 kW of charging, and the PS2900H stacks print 'Nominal Power' in kilowatts equal to their energy.
The HP-6M installation sheet states 'Nominal Power' as 3600 W, the same output.
